mapper.sql: SCOPE_TYPE=#{scopeType} AND OWNER_USER_ID=#{ownerUserId} AND WS_ID=#{wsId} AND PROJ_ID=#{projId}
f.SCOPE_TYPE=#{scopeType} AND f.OWNER_USER_ID=#{ownerUserId} AND f.WS_ID=#{wsId} AND f.PROJ_ID=#{projId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.*, CASE WHEN f.SCOPE_TYPE IN ('GROUP', 'PROJECT') AND NVL(wmp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wmp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS CREATOR_NAME, CASE WHEN f.SCOPE_TYPE IN ('GROUP', 'PROJECT') AND NVL(wmp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH WHEN NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT') = 'IMAGE' THEN u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ELSE NULL END AS CREATOR_PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, CASE WHEN f.SCOPE_TYPE IN ('GROUP', 'PROJECT') AND NVL(wmp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN CASE WHEN wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'DEFAULT' END ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT') END AS CREATOR_PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE FROM CONTENT_FILES f LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = f.CREATED_BY LEFT JOIN PROJECTS p ON p.PROJ_ID = f.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES wmp ON wmp.WS_ID = CASE WHEN f.SCOPE_TYPE = 'GROUP' THEN f.WS_ID WHEN f.SCOPE_TYPE = 'PROJECT' THEN p.WS_ID ELSE NULL END AND wmp.USER_ID = f.CREATED_BY WHERE AND f.DELETED_YN = 'Y' AND f.DELETED_BY = #{userId} ORDER BY f.DELETED_AT DESC

SELECT * FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS WHERE AND DELETED_YN='Y' AND DELETED_BY=#{userId} AND (PARENT_FOLDER_ID IS NULL OR PARENT_FOLDER_ID NOT IN (SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS WHERE DELETED_YN='Y' AND DELETED_BY=#{userId})) ORDER BY DELETED_AT DESC

UPDATE CONTENT_FILES f SET FOLDER_ID=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS x WHERE x.FOLDER_ID=f.ORIGINAL_FOLDER_ID AND x.DELETED_YN='N') THEN f.ORIGINAL_FOLDER_ID ELSE NULL END, ORIGINAL_FOLDER_ID=NULL,DELETED_YN='N',DELETED_BY=NULL,DELETED_AT=NULL,UPDATED_BY=#{userId},UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE CONTENT_FILE_ID=#{id} AND DELETED_YN='Y' AND DELETED_BY=#{userId} AND

UPDATE CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS SET ORIGINAL_PARENT_FOLDER_ID=CASE WHEN FOLDER_ID=#{id} THEN PARENT_FOLDER_ID ELSE ORIGINAL_PARENT_FOLDER_ID END,DELETED_YN='Y',DELETED_BY=#{userId},DELETED_AT=SYSDATE,UPDATED_BY=#{userId},UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE FOLDER_ID IN (SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS START WITH FOLDER_ID=#{id} CONNECT BY PRIOR FOLDER_ID=PARENT_FOLDER_ID)

UPDATE CONTENT_FILES SET ORIGINAL_FOLDER_ID=FOLDER_ID,FOLDER_ID=NULL,DELETED_YN='Y',DELETED_BY=#{userId},DELETED_AT=SYSDATE,UPDATED_BY=#{userId},UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE FOLDER_ID IN (SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS START WITH FOLDER_ID=#{id} CONNECT BY PRIOR FOLDER_ID=PARENT_FOLDER_ID) AND DELETED_YN='N'

UPDATE CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS SET PARENT_FOLDER_ID=CASE WHEN FOLDER_ID=#{id} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS x WHERE x.FOLDER_ID=CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS.ORIGINAL_PARENT_FOLDER_ID AND x.DELETED_YN='N') THEN ORIGINAL_PARENT_FOLDER_ID WHEN FOLDER_ID=#{id} THEN NULL ELSE PARENT_FOLDER_ID END, ORIGINAL_PARENT_FOLDER_ID=NULL,DELETED_YN='N',DELETED_BY=NULL,DELETED_AT=NULL,UPDATED_BY=#{userId},UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE FOLDER_ID IN (SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS START WITH FOLDER_ID=#{id} CONNECT BY PRIOR FOLDER_ID=PARENT_FOLDER_ID) AND DELETED_BY=#{userId} AND
